selected.titulo: A hacker broke into John Deere and SharkNinja with an army of AI agents
selected.resumen:
A hacker broke into more than 100 websites using an army of AI agents that mostly operated on their own, according to findings from the AI security firm Norforge. Though Norforge doesn't name the targets, Reuters reports that the victims included companies like John Deere, SharkNinja, and Cummins.

selected.titulo: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
selected.resumen: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
